abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 7. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.
